Solo Piano — Friday Jazz Brunch at Vast

Vast (Devon Tower, 50th floor) is looking for a solo pianist for our
Friday jazz brunch, 11am-2pm, starting the first Friday of next month
and continuing weekly. Standards and light jazz, your own arrangements
welcome. We provide a well-maintained grand piano and a great view of
downtown OKC.

$250 flat for the three-hour set, paid same day via Venmo or check.
Email booking@vastokc.example with a short video or audio sample.
